infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Celeste uses alarms to wake you with the personal content you chose, such as an affirmation, vision, Anchor Scene, dream phrase or your own phrase.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Celeste uses the microphone only when you tap to check two repetitions of the affirmation shown on the screen. The audio is not stored.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Celeste only saves to your photo library the card or video you choose to save when sharing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Celeste does not read or send photos from your photo library. It only saves to your device the card or video you choose when sharing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Celeste uses on-device speech recognition to check two repetitions of the affirmation shown. The transcription is not stored.
